readout: FANA synthesis rate, normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent (fold)
assay_method: Polymerase kinetic profiling (PKPro). 20 nM polymerase, 1 uM 30-mer DNA template, 100 uM each NTP, 1x ThermoPol buffer, 2x LC Green Plus; denature 95 degC 3 min, extend 55 degC 30 min, fluorescence every 6 s; rate from a linear fit of nucleotides per polymerase vs time; mean of three independent replicates.
remark: No WT row: the readout is already normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent, which is 1.0 by definition. The reference sequence is the engineered Tgo-D4K parent, not native Tgo. Position 659 follows the source data, which carries Y and lists the variant as Y659E; the paper text instead calls it H659E. Q93A is listed twice with values differing by 7e-5, and the mean is used.

readout: Fitness under band-pass ampicillin selection, as deposited; higher is more active
assay_method: PFunkel comprehensive codon mutagenesis of TEM-1 across three sub-regions (codons 1-96, 97-192, 193-287), one NNN mutagenic primer per codon, assayed in Escherichia coli with the band-pass selection system of Sohka et al. 2009: cells are plated on tetracycline plus a variable ampicillin concentration and grow only when TEM-1 activity falls inside a window, since too little activity fails the ampicillin challenge while too much prevents the cell-wall damage that induces TetC. Per-variant scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit.
remark: Positions are sequential over the 286-residue preprotein, which matches UniProt P62593 exactly, and not the Ambler numbering the beta-lactamase literature uses; this deposit carries an explicit ambler column and it gives the offset as +2 over sequential 1-236; +3 over sequential 237-249; +4 over sequential 250-286. 20 rows are dropped for naming a terminator rather than an amino acid, all of them readthroughs of the stop at sequential 287. 251 further rows carry no score. The deposit writes its wild-type rows in substitution form as p.XnnX rather than with '=', so the 271 of them are the wild-type protein and collapse to the single WT row at their mean, whose worst spread is 1.422. Score set a-2 is curated; urn:mavedb:00000070-a-4 is byte-identical to it and the two remaining sets in the deposit are nucleotide-level, which this format cannot express.
